ActorTalk: When Liv heard I wanted to try gardening, she gave me a full set of tools, seeds, and manuals... and even recommended a workshop at Dreamglow Gardens.
So, how are you liking your new hobby?
The morning I saw the seedlings break through the soil, I didn't feel pride first—I felt responsibility.
When I reached out to touch their tiny leaves, I worried my frame's heat might burn them, but it didn't. And I realized... this is what my flame is meant to protect—mornings where life begins.
